sections.Profile:
Atlanticus, produced by T.H. Bergmann & Company in April 1960, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine featuring a nautical theme. The game is equipped with four flippers, four pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, and five standup targets.

- Manufacturer: T.H. Bergmann & Company
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 4
- Tags: Travel, Original Theme
